messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning a deploy to dedicated capacity slice-eu-2 today at 10:30 UTC. Change is an autoscaler tweak + pool tag rotation. Keeping it low-risk but want sign-offs and smoke coverage.

samir: I'm on deploy. Will kick at 10:30 and monitor the rollout. Can someone own smoke checks? :eyes:

jess: I can run smoke. I'll do the simple latency/throughput and model correctness checks. Where are the smoke scripts?

maya: @jess smoke scripts are at https://redwood.internal/tools/smoke/slice-eu-2 and runbook at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-deploy. Quick checklist: 1) smoke latency < 120ms p50, 2) embeddings match baseline, 3) no error spike in trace dashboard.

ryan: FYI rollback plan: revert autoscaler policy and tag rotation, drain new nodes, and point traffic back to slice-eu-1. I have the rollback playbook. I'll be standing by until 11:00 UTC.

samir: Noted. Deploy steps I'll run: 
```
# deploy autoscaler policy
rbx infra apply -f infra/autoscaler/slice-eu-2/2026-03-17-policy.yaml
# rotate pool tag
rbx pool rotate --pool slice-eu-2 --from-tag t1 --to-tag t2
```
I'll post statuses after each step.

infra-bot: @channel Deployment plan validated: infra lint OK, required approvals present (maya, anita). Scheduled window: 10:30-11:00 UTC.

anita: Approved. Confirmed cost impact estimate: ~6% reduction on idle hours with this policy (weekdays). :money_with_wings:

jess: Got the scripts. I'll run smoke as soon as the rotation finishes. Will paste a short summary.

samir: Starting step 1 (apply autoscaler) at 10:30:15 UTC.

samir: step 1 complete at 10:30:42 UTC — policy applied. No immediate errors.

samir: Starting step 2 (tag rotation) at 10:31:10 UTC.

samir: step 2 complete at 10:32:05 UTC — new nodes healthy, 3/3 passing healthchecks.

jess: Running smoke now (invoking smoke-runner).

jess: smoke results: latency p50 98ms, p95 210ms; embeddings cosine diff < 0.003 vs baseline; traces no error spike. :white_check_mark:

ryan: Observability check: no increase in 5xx, tail latency stable, token throughput up ~2% (expected). Good to keep this in prod.

maya: Great. Notes for post-deploy: update capacity.md and open a short PR with the policy file pointer. Also add a short blurb in the release notes.

samir: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1982 created with the applied policy YAML.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued and completed steps recorded. Rollback window expires at 11:00 UTC.

anita: Quick question — any risk to dedicated customers on committed pools?

maya: Low risk. This slice is non-committed capacity used for overflow/short-lived workloads. No change to reserved pools.

jess: I'll re-run smoke at 10:55 before we close the window and post final sign-off.

jess: final smoke at 10:55:20: all green. Signing off.

ryan: I'll mark rollback not needed and archive the incident-runbook pointer.

maya: Thank you everyone. Follow-up: validate cost metrics in 24h and flag if anything odd. :tada:
